system.description:
Tactical Re-Deployment. After the enemies' Combat States are revealed, you may change the Combat State of yourself or one ally.

People Are Pawns (Flaw). When you target an enemy that is in a Brawl with an ally, roll a CR 1 Luck Check. On a failure you hit the ally instead.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.93
system.abilitySummary: After the enemies' Combat States are revealed, you may change the Combat State of yourself or one ally.
system.abilityDescription: After the enemies' Combat States are revealed, you may change the Combat State of yourself or one ally.

automation.note: Once the enemies' Combat States are revealed, move yourself or one ally to a different Combat State.

system.flawSummary: When you target an enemy that is in a Brawl with an ally, roll a CR 1 Luck Check. On a failure you hit the ally instead.
system.flawDescription: When you target an enemy that is in a Brawl with an ally, roll a CR 1 Luck Check. On a failure you hit the ally instead.

flawAutomation.label: People Are Pawns (targeting an enemy in a Brawl with an ally)
flawAutomation.onSuccess: Your attack goes ahead against the enemy.
flawAutomation.onFail: You hit your ally instead of the enemy.

flawAutomation.note: On a failure, resolve your Strike against the ally instead of the enemy (by hand). Use spends Tactical Re-Deployment, so to roll this check post the Background to chat (speech-bubble icon) and click its Roll button.
